messages:
alex: quick flag — ran the monthly reservations audit and there's a small cluster of RIs in us-west-2 that look completely idle since Jan. low-dollar but annoying.
infra-bot: automated RI-scan report: 6 RIs (p4d.24xlarge) with <10% utilization across last 60 days. projected wasted commit: ~$9k/quarter. report: https://redwood.internal/riscans/1765432100
maya: yikes. are those cross-az or zonal?
alex: zonal — all in us-west-2a. our current fleet in that AZ was scaled down after the spot outage in Nov.
sam: can we down-convert or modify? maybe convert to savings plan?
luis: AWS lets you modify scoped RIs to other AZs within the same region but not change family. these are p4d specific. conversion to SP would require a new purchase and return of RIs, messy.
alex: I dumped the resource list — pasted below. small script, 2 commands:
```
aws ec2 describe-reserved-instances --filters Name=state,Values=active Name=availability-zone,Values=us-west-2a --query 'ReservedInstances[*].{ID:ReservedInstancesId,InstanceType:InstanceType,Scope:AvailabilityZone,Start:Start,End:End,Util:Util}'
# produced csv attached in report
```
maya: is there an owner tag? maybe leftovers from an old PoC cluster.
infra-bot: tag-scan result: 4/6 have no owner tag, 2 tagged owner=research-poc.
sam: propose: 1) try shift workloads (if any) into that AZ for 30d can get utilization up, 2) if not possible, schedule return/partial-term modification before renewal window, 3) finance to model refund vs keep.
luis: note — early termination refunds for RIs are negligible. better to try consolidation or exchange if eligible. also check whether Dedicated capacity or Dedicated Hosts unintentionally matched these RIs.
finance-ops: looping in finance ops — can you drop the CSV and a forecast? we'll run a cost-benefit for returning vs covering with spot/savings plan.
alex: uploaded csv to the shared drive + quick notes: https://redwood.internal/drive/teams/infra/riscans/1765432100.csv
maya: also noticed some RI start/end alignment mismatches — two of them expire within 45 days. if we don't act we auto-renew on the portal and that will be a pain.
sam: ok action items: alex to create a cooling period and tag sweep job to attach owners for 7 days; if still unclaimed, luis to open modification/return ticket with AWS before renewal. finance-ops to model options by EOD Wed.
alex: pinging @research-poc channel to check owners, starting the 7-day owner-tag sweep now :eyes:
infra-bot: reminder scheduled: owner-tag-sweep job started (job-id: ots-7761). will post results in 7 days. :robot_face:
